job.title: Domain Lead (m/w/d) E-Commerce IT
job.location: Isernhagen Farster Bauerschaft, Lower Saxony, Germany
job.email_subject: Application: Domain Lead E-Commerce IT – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a Domain Lead who understands the whole e-commerce landscape – I have designed and run enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration
– Code reviews, technical mentoring and requirements work with business teams

I am used to guiding developers through code reviews and mentoring and to aligning priorities with business stakeholders. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce IT Domain Expert | Commerce Platforms, Integrations & Solution Design
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce IT professional with 5+ years designing, extending and running enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Covers the full domain: storefront and headless APIs, order management, promotions, product catalog and PIM / ERP / MDM integration. Combines solution design and requirements engineering with stakeholder management, CI/CD release cycles, production support, code reviews and technical mentoring in agile, international teams. Uses generative AI tools across analysis and delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: CBR Fashion Group runs strong brands like Street One and Cecil with e-commerce at the core of growth. I want to bring my end-to-end commerce experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell – platform, integrations and business requirements – to lead your e-commerce IT domain forward and support the next stage of your digital growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am applying for Domain Lead E-Commerce IT at CBR: 5+ years designing and running enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, integrations, solution design and mentoring. Based in Germany – glad to connect!

en.subject: Application: Domain Lead E-Commerce IT
en.hook: A Domain Lead E-Commerce IT needs to understand the whole commerce landscape – shop, interfaces and the business behind it. That end-to-end view is what I bring: for more than five years I have designed, extended and supported enterprise commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, from headless APIs to PIM and ERP integration.

bullets.label: End-to-end commerce domain
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Integration landscape
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Solution design with the business
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Technical guidance
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues and provided technical guidance to junior developers; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved system stability and data consistency.

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
